us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1-2 days

articles.title: Wife of U.S. soldier released from federal immigration custody
bullets: Maisa Lopes Eliaser was removed from a deportation flight to Brazil.
She had spent more than a month in federal immigration detention.
Her husband is U.S. Army Staff Sgt. Alexis Jaramillo.

articles.title: Michigan shootings leave five people and suspect dead
bullets: Police said shootings in Missaukee County left five victims dead.
A wounded person was taken to a hospital in critical condition.
Authorities later found suspect Chad Hickman dead in a wooded area.

articles.title: Judge refuses to block border wall work on tribal reservation
bullets: A judge declined to stop Trump administration border wall construction.
The dispute involves land tied to the Tohono O’odham Nation.
The ruling allows the project to continue while legal challenges proceed.

articles.title: Trump defends USS Lincoln’s extended Middle East deployment
bullets: Trump said the carrier’s record time at sea was “not nearly long enough.”
Reports cited mental health concerns among some sailors.
The Navy said it had not observed an increase in suicidal ideation.

articles.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to let White House ballroom work continue
bullets: The administration asked the Supreme Court to allow construction during appeal.
The project is described as a $400 million White House ballroom.
A lower-court order had halted the work.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1-2 days

articles.title: Magnitude 7.7 quake off Indonesia kills at least 40
bullets: The quake struck near Indonesia’s Flores region at shallow depth.
Officials reported deaths, collapsed buildings and several aftershocks.
Authorities initially issued tsunami warnings for several provinces.

articles.title: Two UAE tankers attacked while transiting Strait of Hormuz
bullets: Two UAE tankers were hit by drone attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
AP reported the attacks amid continuing Middle East tensions.
Images showed flames and smoke from a strike in Yemen’s port of Mokha.

articles.title: British sociologist Jason Arday found dead after Cambridge resignation
bullets: Jason Arday was found dead after resigning from Cambridge.
He had been known as the youngest Black professor at the university.
The case followed public plagiarism allegations and scrutiny.

articles.title: Peru escalates crackdown on illegal gold mining in Amazon reserve
bullets: Peru stepped up operations against illegal gold mining.
The activity has spread into a protected Amazon reserve.
Authorities linked the campaign to environmental and security concerns.

articles.title: Brazil Supreme Court upholds laws tied to Amazon soy moratorium setback
bullets: Brazil’s Supreme Court backed state laws affecting the soy moratorium.
The rulings involve tax incentives and Amazon deforestation policy.
The decision is a setback for a major anti-deforestation supply-chain tool.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1-2 days

articles.title: Modi outlines ‘Sapta Dhara’ roadmap in Independence Day speech
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed India from the Red Fort.
He outlined a seven-point ‘Sapta Dhara’ vision for Viksit Bharat.
Themes included manufacturing, agriculture, technology, defence and green growth.

articles.title: Modi sets 100GW nuclear power goal by 2047
bullets: Modi said India aims for 100GW of nuclear power by 2047.
He said five new nuclear reactors are targeted for this decade.
The plan was framed as part of India’s energy self-reliance push.

articles.title: Arunachal Pradesh flash floods kill four; five Army personnel missing
bullets: Flash floods and a landslide hit Arunachal Pradesh.
Officials reported four deaths and five Army personnel missing.
Search and rescue efforts were underway after the landslide.

articles.title: Rajasthan to introduce Uniform Civil Code, chief minister says
bullets: Chief Minister Bhajanlal Sharma announced plans for a Uniform Civil Code.
He linked the step to Rajasthan’s broader development agenda.
The announcement came during Independence Day remarks.

articles.title: Modi pitches AI, jobs, coaching and sports initiatives for Gen Z
bullets: Modi highlighted youth-focused measures in his Independence Day speech.
The offerings included AI skills, jobs, free coaching and sports initiatives.
He framed Gen Z as central to India’s development goals.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top U.S. market movers and market-moving stock stories

articles.title: S&P 500 slips 0.2% after prior record close
bullets: The S&P 500 fell 0.2% Friday after setting a record Thursday.
AP reported the Dow was down 304.52 points for the year-to-date tally cited.
The Nasdaq remained up about 15% for the year in AP’s index summary.

articles.title: Cava shares fall after same-restaurant sales miss forecasts
bullets: Cava reported Q2 revenue growth but same-restaurant sales missed expectations.
TradingView reported the stock fell sharply after the update.
The disappointment weighed on other restaurant shares.

articles.title: CoreWeave swings after AI infrastructure earnings
bullets: CoreWeave reported strong revenue growth for the quarter.
Investors focused on capacity, spending and profitability questions.
The stock remained a closely watched AI-infrastructure mover.

articles.title: Paramount Skydance leads midday movers with sharp rally
bullets: Paramount Skydance surged more than 31% in midday trading coverage.
The move marked one of the largest single-stock gains in the roundup.
The rally came alongside multiple earnings and analyst-driven movers.

articles.title: Capri, SailPoint and other names move on upgrades and earnings
bullets: Capri Holdings gained after a JPMorgan upgrade.
SailPoint rose after analyst-upgrade coverage in the mover roundup.
Other movers included Brinker, Hillenbrand, KinderCare and CoreWeave.

articles.title: U.S. retail sales slump unexpectedly after tax-refund boost fades
bullets: Retail sales fell sharply and unexpectedly in July.
AP linked the decline to fading effects from a summer tax-refund boost.
Economists are watching consumer strength ahead of retailer earnings.

articles.title: Walmart expands employee grocery discount to all food items
bullets: Walmart expanded its 10% employee discount to all food products year-round.
The program covers dairy, frozen, dry grocery, meat and seafood.
About 1.6 million U.S. workers are eligible under the expanded benefit.

articles.title: Maryland tax court voids digital ad tax and orders Big Tech refunds
bullets: A Maryland tax court struck down the state’s digital advertising tax.
The ruling orders refunds to companies including Apple, Google and Peacock TV.
The case affects a first-of-its-kind state tax aimed at large digital ad sellers.

articles.title: Reliance to partner Rolls-Royce on fighter jet engines
bullets: Reliance and Rolls-Royce are set to partner on fighter jet engine development.
The story points to India’s push for defence manufacturing capability.
It aligns with broader government emphasis on strategic self-reliance.

articles.title: Restaurant stocks slip after Cava sales growth disappoints
bullets: Cava’s same-restaurant sales growth missed Wall Street expectations.
Shares of several restaurant peers also weakened after the report.
The reaction reflected concern over consumer demand and traffic trends.

articles.title: Jury finds Instagram and YouTube liable in landmark addiction trial
bullets: A New Mexico jury found the platforms harmful to children’s mental health.
The verdict imposed a $375 million penalty.
The case adds pressure on social media companies over youth safety.

articles.title: Parents seek platform changes after social media verdicts
bullets: Parents affected by sextortion and social media harm cases welcomed rulings.
The cases target Meta and other major platform operators.
Families are pressing for stronger safeguards for children online.

articles.title: CoreWeave says older Nvidia A100 GPUs remain profitable
bullets: CoreWeave disclosed contracts using Nvidia A100 GPUs running into 2029.
The chips debuted in 2020 but remain useful amid AI capacity demand.
Power limits and infrastructure constraints are keeping older GPUs economically relevant.

articles.title: Maryland digital ad tax ruling lands win for Big Tech
bullets: A Maryland tax court struck down the state digital ad levy.
Large tech and media companies are due refunds under the ruling.
The decision affects how states can tax online advertising revenue.

articles.title: AI data centers create stress for tech firms and insurers
bullets: Rapid AI data center buildouts are adding risk for private insurers.
The pressure is tied to power, construction and infrastructure exposure.
The issue highlights wider costs from the AI infrastructure boom.
